notes: Only the first printed page-set and inventory pages were available as pictures; placements of many pieces are inferred from small isometric drawings, so exact stud-to-stud attachments (which brick sits on which) are approximate.

Part-to-step assignment of ambiguous Element IDs (e.g. 4211063 as bucket plate, 4211805/306926 as the black-and-gray tower, 4210631 as the front grille with wheat sticker, 241221 as sticker plate, 4167842 as headlight lens) is a best guess from the inventory pictures.
The red 1x6 plates (366621) and arch fenders (4525791) are modelled as stacked; windscreen halves (4543458 x2) sit on the arches and the roof sits on both.
The yellow axle 4193511 is modelled as the rear axle carrying both big wheels; the bucket arms plug into the black angle connectors at the rear.
The farmer minifigure (cap, head, torso, legs, shovel) is built on page 3 and included. Stickers are not separate pieces.
Part type lego-4211069 (plate 1x1 with clip), lego-4210631, lego-366621, lego-302201, lego-74040 and lego-9551 are from the catalogue.
